name: The Drunken Gull
description: A bar with a good name draws good people. Specialists you hire or pick up on a voyage are more often seasoned or veteran, and better at their trade.
levels: A quarter of the specialists you meet are seasoned.
Nearly half are seasoned and a few are veterans.
Half are seasoned and a quarter are veterans.

name: The cartographer's loft
description: An old chart-maker who knows where things were buried. Better charts mean more treasure marked on every sea.
levels: Treasure turns up about twice as often.
Treasure turns up nearly three times as often.

name: The carpenter's yard
description: A slip and a sawpit. Your ship is strengthened before every voyage.

name: The old captain's porch
description: He's too old to sail, but men still follow his word. He finds you a bigger, fuller crew.
levels: Room for 5 more hands, and a fuller crew.
Room for 10 more hands, and a fuller crew.
Room for 15 more hands, and nearly a full crew.
